name: Black Panther
caption: Doesn't count steps. Steps count him.
frenchCaption: Ne compte pas ses pas. Ses pas le comptent.

name: Lone Wolf
caption: Runs alone. Finishes first.
frenchCaption: Court seul. Finit premier.

name: Snow Leopard
caption: Cold start. Hot finish.
frenchCaption: Départ à froid. Arrivée brûlante.

name: Tiger
caption: Wraps on. Excuses off.
frenchCaption: Bandages mis. Excuses au placard.

name: Night Owl
caption: Up at 3 a.m. Still ahead of you.
frenchCaption: Debout à 3 h du matin. Toujours devant toi.

name: Crocodile
caption: Smiles at the finish line. Bad sign.
frenchCaption: Sourit à l’arrivée. Mauvais signe.

name: Peacock
caption: Dressed to win. Also wins.
frenchCaption: Habillé pour gagner. Et il gagne.

name: Flamingo
caption: Stands on one leg. Still out-walks you.
frenchCaption: Tient sur une patte. Marche quand même plus que toi.

name: Persian Cat
caption: Pearls on. Pinky up. Pace up.
frenchCaption: Perles au cou. Petit doigt levé. Allure en hausse.

name: Ostrich
caption: Never buries her head. Only the competition.
frenchCaption: Ne se cache jamais la tête. Elle enterre la concurrence.

name: Cheetah
caption: Fashionably fast. Never fashionably late.
frenchCaption: Rapide avec élégance. En retard, jamais.

name: Bald Eagle
caption: Spotted your step count from up here.
frenchCaption: A repéré ton nombre de pas de là-haut.

name: Silverback
caption: Skips nothing. Especially not leg day.
frenchCaption: Ne saute rien. Surtout pas la séance jambes.

name: Kangaroo
caption: Counts jumps as steps. Nobody argues.
frenchCaption: Compte ses sauts comme des pas. Personne ne discute.

name: Bull
caption: Charges first. Asks questions never.
frenchCaption: Fonce d’abord. Ne pose jamais de questions.

name: Moose
caption: Coach says one more lap. Coach is me.
frenchCaption: Le coach dit encore un tour. Le coach, c’est moi.

name: Bison
caption: Skipping rope. Never skipping cardio.
frenchCaption: Saute à la corde. Ne saute jamais le cardio.

name: Camel
caption: Hydrated in 2019. Still going.
frenchCaption: Hydraté en 2019. Toujours en route.

name: Panda
caption: Bubble tea first. Then domination.
frenchCaption: Bubble tea d’abord. Domination ensuite.

name: Capybara
caption: Unbothered. Undefeated.
frenchCaption: Imperturbable. Invaincu.

name: Hedgehog
caption: Prickly before coffee. Fast after.
frenchCaption: Piquant avant le café. Rapide après.

name: Ginger Cat
caption: Woke up at noon. Won by dinner.
frenchCaption: Réveillé à midi. Vainqueur avant le dîner.

name: Alpaca
caption: Spits on rest days only.
frenchCaption: Ne crache que les jours de repos.

name: Seal
caption: Warm flippers. Cold competition.
frenchCaption: Nageoires au chaud. Concurrence au frais.

name: Hamster
caption: Small legs. Unreasonable cardio.
frenchCaption: Petites pattes. Cardio déraisonnable.

name: Tree Frog
caption: Hops count double. Allegedly.
frenchCaption: Les sauts comptent double. Paraît-il.

name: Mouse
caption: Small steps. So many of them.
frenchCaption: Petits pas. Tellement nombreux.

name: Guinea Pig
caption: Squeaks politely. Walks relentlessly.
frenchCaption: Couine poliment. Marche sans relâche.

name: Duck
caption: Small duck. Big lift. Bigger quack.
frenchCaption: Petit canard. Grosse barre. Coin-coin encore plus gros.

name: Donkey
caption: Stubborn about cardio. In a good way.
frenchCaption: Têtu sur le cardio. Dans le bon sens.
